about_the_game:
I like trains...

In Logistik, you manage a railway network and the trains that run on it. You can:

  • Lay rails across plains, mountains, rivers, and bustling cities: pick the cheapest path or brave the tough terrains for extra rewards.

  • Plan timetables: Optimize routes, balance fuel consumption, and keep commuters smiling!

  • Recreate iconic European lines or unleash your imagination to build your ideal railway network.

  • Compete in challenges and climb the leaderboard to prove who truly masters logistics 😎

Rail network management

Lay tracks between stations and optimize building costs when building in open fields, or on more difficult places such as rivers, forests, or even inside cities!

Route planification

Plan and optimize routes to fulfill transport demands. Make people happy by carrying them around the map and transporting their favorite goods close to home!

Compete against other players on the current challenge map

Play the same map as the other players and see if you can score more point than them, then compare your scores on a global leaderboard!

Manage your railway network on some real-life maps

Do you want to try creating your own rail network in your favorite country, or even on the whole European continent ? There's a map for you to do that!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22+ (64 bit only) / SteamOS 3+ (64 bit only)
  • Processor: 2 GHz Dual core
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Storage: 750 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: GLIBC_2.38 should be supported on your OS for the game to run

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: MacOS 12+
  • Processor: 2 GHz Dual core
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Storage: 1500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Intel and apple-sillicon compatible

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7+ (64 bit only)
  • Processor: 2 GHz Dual core
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Storage: 750 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64 bit only)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
